tbesh_html:
1) glory, cloak
1a) glory, splendour, magnificence (of a vine, shepherds)
1b) mantle, cloak made of fur or fine material
1b1) prophet's garment

strongs_1890.strongs_def: something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress)
strongs_1890.derivation: feminine of H117 (אַדִּיר); ; also the same as H145 (אֶדֶר)
